purpose: Validate exact non-anchor command screening, capacity potentials, and transfer of reduced-catalog global certificates to an explicitly bound original instance.
development_disclosure: The deletion bounds were derived after inspecting the R49 reports and R52 source/results. R52 examples are known development material. No R53 screening experiments have run at this protocol commit. This is an algorithmic regression and controlled synthetic study, not statistical preregistration.

checks: capacity-potential identity on every catalog arc
canonical target-preserving deletion bound on all feasible books and 11 equally spaced feasible targets per history
independent original-policy and complete Bellman verification
screening-chain verification by independent breakpoint evaluation

reporting: Report every prescribed case, actual counts, exceptions, and measured runtimes. Do not replace inherited R52 or earlier results. Positive-width certificates are not exact solutions. Timing includes declared screening/optimization/checking components, and no real application calibration is claimed.
